record.reason: Primary abstract: Designed to address the challenge of identifying water surface floating objects with transparent features under complex backgrounds such as irritating light sources, we introduce Edge-Aware Detection Transformer(EA-DETR), a novel end-to-end object detection model based on DINO-ResNet50.
record.title: EA-DETR: Edge-Aware Detection Transformer for Water Surface Floating Object Identification
